name: 模具（检测/三坐标/测量）报告

map.输入三坐标测量机(CMM)测量的实际坐标值与理论值，计算偏差并判定是否在公差范围: Input the actual coordinates from a CMM and the nominal values to compute deviation and judge whether it is within tolerance
map.三坐标偏差：各轴偏差 dx = 实测 x − 理论 x（y、z 同理）；空间偏差: CMM deviation: per-axis deviation dx = measured x - nominal x (same for y, z); spatial deviation = sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2 + dz^2); when all per-axis absolute deviations and the spatial deviation are within tolerance, judge PASS, otherwise OUT-OF-TOLERANCE (FAIL) and list the out-of-tolerance axes.
map.记录模具关键尺寸的三坐标测量结果。: Record CMM measurement results of key mold dimensions.
map.与图纸公差对比判定合格性。: Compare with drawing tolerance to judge pass/fail.
map.形成模具验收与维修依据报告。: Form a report as the basis for mold acceptance and repair.
map.实测值超出图纸公差即需修正电极或补焊，避免带病投产造成批量不良。: If the measured value exceeds the drawing tolerance, correct the electrode or build up weld to avoid batch defects from sick production.
map.平行度、同轴度等形位公差需在三坐标上逐项测量，作为模具验收的量化依据。: Geometric tolerances such as parallelism and coaxiality must be measured point by point on the CMM as quantified mold-acceptance evidence.
map.提供可追溯的量化数据，既用于验收，也为后续磨损趋势与维修提供基准。: It provides traceable quantitative data for acceptance and a baseline for wear trend and repair.
map.测量结果受温度影响吗？: Are measurement results affected by temperature?
map.会。应统一在 20℃ 标准温度下测量，或按材料线膨胀系数做温度补偿。: Yes. Measure uniformly at the 20 C standard temperature, or apply temperature compensation by the material's linear expansion coefficient.
map.三坐标测量机(CMM)精度通常为(1.5+L/300)μm，测量前需进行探针校准: CMM accuracy is typically (1.5+L/300)um; probe calibration is required before measuring
map.公差判定依据图纸标注的尺寸公差带，本工具默认对称公差±T: Tolerance judgment follows the dimension tolerance band on the drawing; this tool defaults to symmetric tolerance +/-T
map.空间偏差为三轴偏差的矢量和，反映实际点偏离理论点的总距离: Spatial deviation is the vector sum of the three-axis deviations, reflecting the total distance of the actual point from the nominal point
map.测量环境温度应控制在20±2℃，避免热膨胀影响测量精度: Measurement environment temperature should be controlled at 20+/-2 C to avoid thermal expansion affecting accuracy
map.多点测量建议逐点记录后导出完整报告，用于模具验收: For multi-point measurement, record point by point then export a complete report for mold acceptance
map.模具三坐标测量报告工具，输入理论坐标与实测坐标，自动计算各轴偏差和空间偏差，判定: Mold CMM report tool: input nominal and measured coordinates, auto-compute per-axis and spatial deviations, judging whether within tolerance.
